name: independentLiquidGravity
description: Liquid gravity is a constant

name: proportionalLiquidGravity
description: Liquid gravity is a proportion of normal gravity

name: velocityBlocksOnCollision
description: Velocity changes are caused by blocks are triggered by collision with the block

name: climbUsingJump
description: Entity can climb ladders and vines by pressing jump

name: climbableTrapdoor
description: Trapdoors placed directly above ladders become climbable

name: mthSinDouble
description: Mth.sin/cos take a double and index the table as a long (26.1 sources, 1.21.11)

name: floatMoveRelative
description: moveRelative (moveFlying) computes the input in float, and ground speed divides by the cube of slipperiness * 0.91

name: moveRelativeYawPiOver180
description: moveFlying turns the yaw into radians as yaw * 3.1415927F / 180.0F

name: frictionCubeOfSlipperiness
description: Ground speed is speed * (0.21600002F / slipperiness^3)

name: frictionConstant16277137
description: Ground speed constant 0.16277137F (0.16277136F before)

name: vec3NormalizeFloatSqrt
description: Vec3.normalize takes the length through Mth.sqrt, a float

name: squareMovementInput
description: The movement input is normalized, scaled by 0.98 and the sneak factor, then stretched to the unit square (LocalPlayer.modifyInput)

name: playerHorizontalVelocityThreshold
description: The player drops its horizontal velocity when its squared length is below 9.0E-6

name: velocityThreshold005
description: Velocity components below 0.005 are dropped (0.003 since 1.9)

name: airSprintSpeedFloatSum
description: Sprinting air speed is 0.02F + 0.006F in float

name: jumpBoostFloatSum
description: The jump boost is added to the jump power in float

name: jumpBoostFloatSum
description: The jump boost is added to the jump power in float

name: jumpSprintBoostDouble
description: The sprint jump boost is Mth.sin(yaw) * 0.2 in double

name: jumpKeepsHigherVelocity
description: A jump keeps a higher upward velocity

name: voxelShapeCollision
description: Collisions use VoxelShapes: faces count within 1e-7, other axes must overlap by more than 1e-7, moves under 1e-7 are dropped

name: modernMove
description: Entity.collide: y then the larger horizontal axis first, the combined step-up, the move applied only above 1e-7 squared, Mth.equal horizontal collision

name: candidateStepUpHeights
description: The step up tries the heights of the colliders faces within the step, lowest first

name: passengerAttachmentPoints
description: Passengers sit on the vehicle's attachment point (Entity.getPassengerAttachmentPoint); before, on its riding offset plus their own (the player's -0.35)

name: entityAttachments
description: Passengers sit on EntityAttachments points (the player's vehicle attachment 0.6 in double); before, on float riding offsets

name: passengerNoPushOut
description: LocalPlayer.aiStep: a passenger is not pushed out of blocks

name: passengerNoCrouch
description: LocalPlayer.aiStep excludes passengers when computing the crouching state

name: shiftKeyWhileGliding
description: LocalPlayer.isShiftKeyDown reads the held input even while fall flying

name: clientRearingLegacy
description: AbstractHorse.stand: the client rears a horse it controls itself (isControlledByLocalInstance), 20 ticks

name: passengerSprintVehicle
description: LocalPlayer.canStartSprinting: a passenger sprints only on a vehicle that can (vehicleCanSprint)

name: airSpeedLastTick
description: Player.aiStep sets the air speed (flyingSpeed, 0.026 sprinting) after the travel: a tick uses the sprint the tick before ended with (getFlyingSpeed since 1.19.4)

name: riddenDamping
description: LivingEntity.aiStep damps a mount the client drives by 0.98 (it is not its effective AI; canSimulateMovement since)

name: javaBoats
description: The vehicle the player drives (boats, horses, camels, a steered pig or strider) and a minecart it rides

name: autoJump
description: LocalPlayer.updateAutoJump: the auto-jump option

name: autoJumpJumpFactor
description: The auto-jump also needs a block that does not weaken the jump (canAutoJump)

name: autoJumpFloatFastInvSqrt
description: The auto-jump normalizes its direction with Mth.fastInvSqrt(float)

name: autoJumpExactInvSqrt
description: The auto-jump normalizes its direction with Mth.invSqrt (1 / sqrt in float)

name: legacyWorldBorder
description: World.getCollisionBoxes: for an entity inside the world border, the cells outside it collide as stone

name: elytraLegacyLift
description: EntityLivingBase.travel gliding before 1.13: motionY += -0.08 + lift * 0.06

name: legacyViewVector
description: Entity.getVectorForRotation before 1.13: cos/sin of (-yaw - PI), the pitch's cosine negated

name: legacyPlayerSize
description: EntityPlayer.updateSize: 1.65 tall while sneaking, 0.6 while gliding; a resized box keeps its lower corner

name: positionFromBoxCenter
description: After a move the position is the center of the moved bounding box

name: moveWhenFullyBlocked
description: A move also applies when the collided movement is within 1e-7 of the requested one

name: collisionEpsilonVelocityReset
description: The velocity is reset on the axes that collided by more than 1e-5 (Mth.equal); before, on any difference, the z reset restoring x

name: waterMovementEfficiency
description: Depth strider acts through the water_movement_efficiency attribute (0.33333334F per level, no division by 3)

name: crouchLag
description: The sneak slowdown comes from the crouching state, taken from the sneak key of the tick before

name: blockSpeedFactor
description: Soul sand and honey slow the player through the block speed factor (0.4F) at the end of the move, of the block it is in or else the one below

name: blockBelowHalfBlock
description: The block below that sets friction and factors is 0.5000001 under the feet (one block before)

name: blockBelowOnPos
description: The block below is taken 0.500001F under the feet (getOnPos)

name: movementEfficiency
description: The block speed factor is lerped toward 1 by the movement_efficiency attribute (soul speed)

name: supportingBlock
description: The player keeps the block it stands on (checkSupportingBlock); getOnPos looks in its column

name: blockEffectsAfterTravel
description: Block effects (stepOn, checkInsideBlocks) run after the whole travel (applyEffectsFromBlocks), not inside the move

name: lavaFluidHeight
description: Lava is detected by its fluid height like water (pushing 0.0023333), and a weak current is raised to 0.0045

name: unifiedFluidInteraction
description: EntityFluidInteraction: water and lava in one pass, heights in double from the undeflated box bottom, both updated again after the move

name: skipClientControlledFallCheck
description: 1.21.4 skips Entity.move's fall check for client-controlled players and mounts, including the post-move water refresh

name: insideBlocksAlongPath
description: Blocks act along the move: the cells of the start and end boxes, walked in the direction of travel (the end box alone before)

name: insideBlocksAxisSteps
description: Blocks act for each axis step of the move (in the collided move order; the requested one from 1.21.9), not for the whole tick

name: insideBlocksEndIntersect
description: A block acts only when the box at the end of the step touches it (or the step is longer than a block)

name: bubbleSurfaceByShape
description: A bubble column is at the surface when the block above has no collision and no fluid (air before)

name: worldBorderCollider
description: The world border shape is always among the colliders of a move while inside it (only near the border since)

name: playerPhysicsAttributes
description: Gravity, jump strength and step height are attributes

name: sprintState
description: The player keeps a sprint state: the sprint key starts it when allowed, the game stops it (released forward, collision, water...)

name: sprintStopsWhenSlow
description: Sneaking, blindness and gliding stop sprinting (LocalPlayer.shouldStopSprinting)

name: sprintNotWhileGliding
description: Sprinting cannot start while gliding

name: minorHorizontalCollision
description: A collision within 8 degrees of the input direction does not stop sprinting

name: eyeFluidOffset
description: The eyes are taken 0.11111111 lower when checking for water

name: elytraDoubleCos
description: The elytra lift takes cos(pitch) in double (Math.cos), not through Mth.cos as a float

name: elytraSquareOnly
description: The elytra lift is cos(pitch)^2 without the look length factor

name: bedBounce
description: Beds bounce a falling entity back up at 0.66F of its speed

name: restitutionBounce
description: Collisions restitute the movement (Entity.restituteMovementAfterCollisions): slime 1.0 and beds 0.75 bounce, with the unused gravity and drag undone

name: swiftSneak
description: Swift sneak adds 0.15F per level to the 0.3F sneak factor (the sneaking_speed attribute from 1.21)

name: insideBlocksInset1e7
description: The blocks inside the player are those of the box shrunk by 1e-7 (0.001 before)
